item.title: Shoulder Transition with Rifle – Shooting Fundamentals
item.description: If you have ever spent any serious time training with your rifle, you have undoubtedly run into a barricade or corner on your offside. These can be challenging because our ultimate goal is to minimize our exposure at any edge. Leaning out and making the shot is an option, but it comes at the cost of major body exposure. Today, we will look at a shoulder transition technique that will allow you to switch hands and maintain better cover while shooting. iFrame is not supported! Shoulder Transition
